_doc: D2. State: { change: { node, diff }, passage: { id, relation, text } }. One call per (node, candidate passage).

needed.instructions: Would a reviewer need to read `passage.text` to judge whether the change in `change.diff` is correct (for example because it calls the changed code, is called by it, tests it, or documents its behavior)?

criteria.true: Reading the passage could change the review verdict
criteria.false: The passage is unrelated or only incidentally mentions the same names
